Joyful Life With Jesus Ministries: A churchthat goesto you.

Full Gospel Trinitarian Christian Church. Four congregations, one family, in Manila Hills, Camarines Sur, Mindoro and Payatas.

Plan your visitLight a candle

“Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.”

Matthew 5:14, KJV

Camsur, Masuli Bato

Where the Word is preached from a simple stage under a tin roof, with flowers hung by the congregation’s own hands. Jesus is the way, the truth and the life.

Camarines Sur’s story is being gathered from its pastor and will appear here.

Sta. Cruz, Occidental Mindoro

A young congregation that has already celebrated its third anniversary, gathered in green, standing together under one banner: Jesus is God.

This chapter’s story is waiting on the pastor’s own words.

Payatas, Springfield

Under a plain wooden cross and the glittering name of Jesus, the Word is preached. The hall also fills with children for Daily Vacation Bible School.

This chapter’s story is waiting on the pastor’s own words.

We don’t wait at the door. We go.

When Typhoon Ulysses came, we went.

We didn’t only pray inside the church. We went to where the flood had hit, with help and with generators so people could charge their phones.

When the pandemic came, the services never stopped.

The church kept gathering, because people needed it most.

Known from Narra Street to San Isidro.

Kasiglahan Village and the relocation area know us as neighbors.

Four lights, one hope: unity.

Manila Hills, Camsur, Mindoro and Springfield, one church family.

Can we pray for you?

Tell us what’s on your heart. Each request lights a candle.
